race.title: Midnite Built Different Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: FLAGBEARER makes obvious appeal as an unexposed 3-y-o from a leading stable and he can make a successful start to his handicap career. Must Believe added to his strong record on all-weather when scoring at Chelmsford under Billy Loughnane 19 days ago and is second choice ahead of Codiak . FLAGBEARER MUST BELIEVE CODIAK (IRE)
